# DigiPet

An original digital-monster style virtual pet for the Flipper Zero.

## How to play
- **Left/Right** choose an action: Feed, Train, Battle, Clean, Medic, Status.
- **OK** performs the selected action.
- **Back** exits (your pet is saved).

Your pet hatches from an egg into Blipling, grows into Clawpup, and then evolves
into Pyrodrake with good care or Sludgeon if neglected.

Progress is saved to the SD card and the pet keeps aging while the app is
closed (up to 24 hours), so don't forget to come back and feed it.
